hlg_91b57471207e9b44_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to submit, modify, confirm, and receive notifications for order changes due to insufficient availability, while ensuring all orders meet minimum quantity requirements.
hlg_91b57471207e9b44_001.rationale: llg_001 enables customers to submit orders with minimum quantity constraints; llg_002 allows modification of existing orders by altering quantities or items; llg_003 triggers confirmation and system validation; llg_004 introduces a distinct capability to notify customers of availability-driven changes and provide API-based acceptance/rejection, which is materially different from the other goals and must be explicitly included.

hlg_1c190ea7f86685cf_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to monitor wallet balances, receive payment notifications, manage insufficient funds with grace periods, recharge wallets via in-store terminals or online transfers, and process partial payments for orders.
hlg_1c190ea7f86685cf_001.rationale: llg_001 enables customers to check wallet balance and payment status, which supports awareness of fund availability. llg_002 enables real-time payment notifications, enhancing transparency. llg_003 introduces a grace period mechanism for insufficient funds, adding a customer-centric recovery path. llg_004 and llg_005 define two distinct recharge channels (in-store and online), preserving the modality of payment method and location. llg_006 introduces partial payment capability, which is materially different from full payments and must be explicitly included to avoid misrepresentation of scope.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Check wallet balance and payment status
Handle insufficient balance with grace period

hlg_45d7b64c9eb54357_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to schedule, be reminded of, and be notified about missed pickup events for product pickup at stores, including enforcement of forfeit policies upon missed pickups.
hlg_45d7b64c9eb54357_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the customer to select a pickup time slot based on store availability; llg_002 ensures the customer receives a reminder notification before the pickup time to confirm attendance; llg_003 ensures the customer is notified if they miss their pickup time and is informed of the forfeit policy consequences — which introduces an unrelated or broader capability (enforcement of policy consequences) that must be explicitly included to expose the mismatch.

hlg_d7aace6841b88a6b_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable farmers to submit, update, and confirm product availability estimates for dynamic allocation and order fulfillment, with real-time updates and a Monday-morning confirmation deadline.
hlg_d7aace6841b88a6b_001.rationale: llg_001 enables initial submission of product availability estimates for dynamic allocation; llg_002 adds real-time update capability via API to reflect stock or delivery changes; llg_003 introduces a mandatory Monday-morning confirmation of final quantities available for order, which is a distinct lifecycle phase and deadline not covered by the other goals.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Confirm final product quantities available for order

hlg_5c82e14395e9d14b_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Implement a dynamic customer prioritization system during shortages that calculates, updates, and displays a fair-play score to determine order priority and enable customer self-service visibility.
hlg_5c82e14395e9d14b_001.rationale: llg_001 enables automatic prioritization of customer orders during shortages based on fair-play score; llg_002 enables customers to view their fair-play score for transparency; llg_003 enables the system to calculate and update the fair-play score via API using order history, reminders, or penalties. Together, these form a closed-loop system of score computation, display, and prioritization — with no inferred functionality or hidden parent goal.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Prioritize customer based on fair-play score

hlg_d714bbf6da86e761_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable store employees to manage end-to-end order fulfillment, including coordination of product pickup, processing customer payments, and confirming delivery status to update system records.
hlg_d714bbf6da86e761_001.rationale: llg_001 enables store employees to view and manage pending orders for fulfillment; llg_002 adds the capability to coordinate pickup logistics including time and location; llg_003 introduces payment processing and wallet balance updates via system API; llg_004 adds the capability to confirm delivery status and update system records. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of order fulfillment from initiation to delivery confirmation, with explicit handling of pickup logistics and payment integration.

hlg_c12fcb1e0bd72453_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Automatically notify farmers and customers of delivery delays, cancel late orders, credit back missing amounts with a 20% bonus, and provide estimated resolution times via API.
hlg_c12fcb1e0bd72453_001.rationale: llg_001 adds notification to farmers with automatic 20% bonus credit on delays; llg_002 adds notification to customers with estimated resolution time; llg_003 adds automatic 20% bonus credit for missing amounts; llg_004 adds order cancellation and 20% bonus credit for late deliveries — all via API. These capabilities are distinct and must be preserved as they represent different actors (farmer vs. customer), different actions (notify, cancel, credit), and different outcomes (bonus, resolution time).

hlg_efa2b8dc66a64b34_001.rationale: llg_001 adds transaction recording and payment enforcement; llg_002 enforces forfeit policy for missed pickups; llg_003 updates fair-play score based on customer behavior including missed pickups and forfeits; llg_004 notifies customers of insufficient wallet balance at order placement via email; llg_005 notifies customers of insufficient wallet balance at payment execution via SMS; llg_006 cancels orders if wallet remains insufficient by Monday evening; llg_007 assigns pickup time slots based on fair-play score during shortages; llg_008 sends SMS reminders for missed pickups; llg_009 marks orders as forfeited and updates fair-play score if not collected by Friday. All these capabilities are distinct and must be preserved to accurately represent the system’s scope.
